title: The court map, with each court placed
description: The baseline document with a location added to every court. The CSM report contains no locations — its own `fara-geografie` limitation says so — and these are derived from the court's printed name against the SIRUTA registry, never read from the report. Knowing where a court sits is not knowing what it serves: the arondare is set by law, not by this report, so the limitation stays blocking and the access cost of a closure is still unanswerable from this document.

$schema.description: Relative path to this schema, so an editor can validate the file in place.

period.description: The reporting year the figures describe.

nationalAverages.description: The averages the report prints for each tier, kept so a derived figure can be checked against the source's own arithmetic.

tier.description: The four levels of the Romanian court hierarchy.

specialised.description: A specialised tribunal — commercial, or for minors and family — which the proposal would fold into the county tribunal as an internal section.

volume.description: Cases on the roll during the year.

loadPerPost.description: Cases per established post, as printed.

loadPerJudge.description: Cases per sitting judge, as printed.

judges.description: Derived: volume / loadPerJudge. The report does not print judge counts, but it prints a ratio built from them, so the count can be recovered — and is marked derived, never verbatim.

posts.description: Derived: volume / loadPerPost. The establishment, which exceeds the sitting judges wherever posts are vacant.

county.description: County code of the place the court sits in.

siruta.description: SIRUTA code of the UAT the court sits in. Null only for a court seated on Bucharest as a whole rather than on one of its six sectors — the city has no single seat.

placedBy.description: How the location was reached, so a reader can weigh it. `name`: the court is named after its seat. `county-seat`: the court is named after a county and sits in that county's capital — the one real assumption here. `city`: seated on Bucharest as a whole.
